bluejetty:00037183:ios.description:
Your All-in-One Reading Companion
ReadKit is a powerful, all-in-one read-later and RSS client that brings together your favorite news, articles, and feeds. With major providers and built-in iCloud RSS and Read Later sync, ReadKit lets you save and read articles later, providing a distraction-free reading experience anytime and anywhere.
KEY FEATURES
• All-in-One Reading Hub: Access all your accounts in one place with multi-account support.
• Cross-Platform: Universal app with full feature parity on iOS and macOS.
• iCloud RSS and Read Later: Built-in services with iCloud sync.
• Flexible Syncing: Sync with major RSS aggregators and read-later services.
• Advanced Organization: Manage feeds, folders, tags and automatically updated smart folders.
• Smart Folder Actions: Mark items read or starred and filter content.
• Offline Access: Read articles offline with cached images.
• Enhanced Reading Experience: Built-in reader mode extracts full article content, with options for automatic activation.
• Wide Gesture Support: Navigate, mark articles read and perform quick actions.
• In-App Browser: View links and references without leaving the app.
• App Badge Preferences: Customize the badge to display the count of unread items.
• Mark as Read Options: Mark articles read while scrolling, by pulling up, or in one tap.
• Contextual Marking: Quickly mark articles as read above or below directly from the context menu.
• Customizable Interface: Choose themes, light or dark mode, and app icons to suit your style.
• Powerful Search: Search articles by content, title, or source.
• Filter Articles: Easily filter articles by read or starred status.
• Background Syncing: Always stay updated with background sync.
• Content Sharing: Use the share extension to save articles from Safari and other apps for later reading.
• Email Articles: Send articles directly via email to share with others.
• Share via Apps and Services: Share articles through the share sheet.
• YouTube Channel Support: Subscribe to YouTube channels and playlists through RSS feeds.
• Full Keyboard Support: Optimized for hardware keyboards on macOS and iPad.
• Feed Import/Export: Import or export subscriptions via OPML files.
• Application Settings Export: Export and import appearance, reading, general behavior and gesture preferences.
Enjoy ReadKit’s essential features completely free — no ads, no data mining. Unlock additional features with ReadKit Premium, available via a universal subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase for iOS, macOS, or both. A free trial is also available.
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Multi-Account Support: Manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
• Unlimited Smart Folders: Create and customize more than one smart folder per account.
• Enhanced Reader Mode: Extract full-text content from articles, even when missing from the feed source.
• Article Summary: summarize articles using AI on supported devices (requires ReadKit Premium, Apple Intelligence and iOS 26).
• Unlimited Feeds: Remove the 20-feed limit for the built-in RSS service.
• Advanced Organization Tools: Organize feeds and articles into folders or tags.
• Image Caching: Enjoy offline reading with cached images.
• Themes & Custom Icons: Unlock exclusive themes and choose custom app icons.
• Full OPML Support: Import and export feed subscriptions with ease.
• Account and Smart Folder Export: Export account settings with smart folders and import them individually.
• Early Access: Enjoy upcoming premium features as they're released.
SUPPORTED SERVICES
• Built-in RSS and Read Later services with iCloud sync.
• News Reader Services: BazQux, Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, FreshRSS, Inoreader, Miniflux, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, Tiny Tiny RSS
• Read Later & Bookmarking Services: Instapaper, Wallabag and Pinboard
Privacy Policy: https://readkit.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://readkit.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00088385:ios.description:
Looking forward to winter? Enough!
Install the Just Snow app and add realistic snow to your photo right now.
What you need
At your disposal more than 30 unique filters, created specifically for Just Snow app. You will definitely find the one that suits you.
Choose one of 4 categories:
1. Small snow - great for landscapes.
2. Bokeh - a large and blurry snow, which will decorate your portrait shots.
3. Motion - inspired by extreme photos and suitable for unusual camera angles.
4. Abstraction - pure imagination, use to create creative works.
Just perfect
Create exellent compositions using the "Mask" tool. The snowfall will never close your face or other important objects. The mask works like an eraser. Choose the ideal shape, for example, for landscapes is useful "Half", and for the portrait a "Circle". Just move the mask to the desired object and set the desired size.
Add a new layer
Not enough snow? Use the layers. Mix filters from different categories. Also this tool works fine with masks. Turn on your fantasy. Arrange a snow storm on your picture.
More colors
What if the snow was not white? You have a great opportunity to look at it. You are guaranteed to get bright and colorful photos. Apply one of the specially selected colors or set any other. One color is good, but two is better - with a gradient the snow looks even more beautiful. Color change is also useful for creating realistic effects, the snow filter can always be adjusted for the current lighting. 
Full customization
Just Snow app provides you with all the tools to make the final image perfect:
1. Set the transparency of the snow filter.
2. Change the saturation of the background, this will add an atmosphere of winter to your photos.
3. Fill the background with a color, it will look like a fog or a blizzard.
4. If the snow filter seems too harsh, you can fix it using a blur.
Always different
If you are bored with standard filters, you can always create your own. To do this, use the generation of particles in pairs with layers and masks. Each time the position of the snowflakes changes and you always get the different effect.
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00028063:android.description:
DS Alarm Clock – Wake Up Smarter, Sleep Better
Start every morning feeling refreshed and in control with DS Alarm Clock, the ultimate alarm app for Android. Whether you're a heavy sleeper, need gentle wake-up sounds, or want powerful time management tools, DS Alarm Clock offers a fully customizable experience that goes beyond just setting alarms.
This all-in-one app combines smart alarms, soothing sleep sounds, reminders, and more to help you take charge of your day from the moment you wake up. With a sleek design and reliable performance, it’s your go-to app for better mornings and restful nights.
⏰ Smart Alarm Features
DS Alarm Clock adapts to your lifestyle and sleep habits with powerful and personalized alarm settings:
Custom Alarm Sounds – Choose from built-in tones, music, nature sounds, or even record your own voice.
Dismiss with Tasks – Force yourself to wake up by solving a puzzle, shaking the phone, or completing a memory game before the alarm stops.
Flexible Snooze Options – Customize snooze intervals and limits to match your sleep needs.
Multiple Alarms – Set alarms for different times, days, or routines – great for work, weekends, naps, and events.
Reliable Alarm Performance – Works even in battery-saving mode or Do Not Disturb. DS Alarm Clock ensures your alarm will always ring when you need it most.
🌙 Sleep Tools to Help You Rest Better
DS Alarm Clock isn't just about waking up – it also helps you fall asleep faster and sleep more soundly:
Sleep Sounds – Access a wide range of relaxing sleep music and nature-inspired sounds, including rain, waves, wind, and white noise.
Bedtime Reminders – Get gentle nudges to help build a healthy sleep routine and wind down on time.
Evening Mode – Pair sleep sounds with a timer for evening meditation, reading, or quiet relaxation.
Upcoming Sleep Tracking – Monitor sleep stages, duration, and quality (coming soon).
Establish a healthier sleep routine that supports your well-being every night.
🕒 All-in-One Time Management
Beyond alarms and sleep tools, DS Alarm Clock offers essential timekeeping and productivity features:
Stopwatch & Timer – Track time for workouts, cooking, focus sessions, or any daily activity.
Daily Reminders – Set task reminders, medication alerts, calendar events, or repeating notifications with ease.
Custom Notification Sounds – Use your favorite tones for reminders or stay focused with minimal alert options.
Clock Widget – Add a beautiful clock and alarm widget to your Android home screen for quick access.
Call Menu Features – Stay productive with reminders during or after phone calls.
🎯 Why DS Alarm Clock?
✅ Easy to Use – Clean, modern UI designed for all ages and skill levels.
✅ Highly Customizable – Make every alarm, reminder, or sleep sound truly yours.
✅ Battery Efficient – Minimal battery use without compromising reliability.
✅ Built for Android – Optimized for all Android devices and versions.
✅ Perfect for Heavy Sleepers – Strong alert features and task-based dismiss options keep you from oversleeping.
From students to professionals, shift workers to night owls, DS Alarm Clock is built for anyone who wants a smarter, smoother start to the day.
🚀 Wake Up With Purpose – Start Every Day Right
With DS Alarm Clock, your mornings will never be the same. Whether you’re tired of snoozing through alarms or looking to enhance your nightly routine, this app is your personalized assistant for better sleep, punctual mornings, and organized days.
Transform how you manage time, sleep, and productivity — all in one app.
📲 Download DS Alarm Clock now and join thousands of users enjoying a more peaceful, effective, and energized life. It’s time to sleep smarter, wake up better, and take control of your day!

bluejetty:00040990:ios.description:
NetProxy - 100% Free VPN Client!
The free, secure, and reliable VPN Client service NetProxy is now on the App Store! 
What is a VPN Client?
NetProxy is NOT an independent VPN provider; it is a client application designed to connect to any existing VPN configuration. Using Free VPN Client by Netproxy, you can securely connect to the VPN provider of your choice by uploading a config file. NetProxy will create a safe and encrypted tunnel for your data. This ensures that your online activities remain private and protected from unauthorised access.
How to Use NetProxy Free VPN Client? 
1. Download the VPN Client app for your device: Get the NetProxy app from the App Store and install it on your device.
2. Upload the configuration to your VPN Client: Use the configuration file provided by your VPN service provider and upload it to the NetProxy app.
3. Connect to the VPN: Once the configuration is uploaded, simply connect to the VPN through the NetProxy app.
Benefits of NetProxy
Seamless Integration
NetProxy's flexible design enables it to seamlessly incorporate various VPN configurations within the NetProxy VPN Client, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free connection. No registration is required. 
Reliable Support 24/7
If you experience any issues, please reach out to us. Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you with any problems or questions you may have.
NetProxy, as a Free VPN Client, ensures user privacy and security through industry-leading encryption techniques. It facilitates the creation of a secure tunnel for data transmission, preventing unauthorized interception or tampering. Just upload your VPN configuration for free and start using it.
Thank you for choosing NetProxy!

bluejetty:00065540:ios.name: Recipe Keeper: CookBook
bluejetty:00065540:ios.summary:
Stop screenshotting dinner ideas. CookBook turns recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites and photos into meals you can plan, shop and cook.
CookBook is a smart recipe keeper loved by thousands of home cooks. Save recipes from anywhere, or
bluejetty:00065540:ios.description:
Stop screenshotting dinner ideas. CookBook turns recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites and photos into meals you can plan, shop and cook.
CookBook is a smart recipe keeper loved by thousands of home cooks. Save recipes from anywhere, organize them into a private digital cookbook, plan meals, create grocery lists, track nutrition and cook with clear steps across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Start free, with a 14-day trial.
SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Import recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest and links. Use the AI recipe scanner to turn photos of handwritten recipe cards, cookbook pages, screenshots and clippings into editable recipes.
ASK COOKBOOK
Ask CookBook is your AI cooking companion for dinner ideas, recipe creation, ingredient swaps, leftover inspiration, meal planning help and cooking questions. Ask what to cook with what you have, how to adapt a recipe or how to make a dish suit your diet.
ORGANIZE YOUR DIGITAL COOKBOOK
Keep every recipe easy to find with tags, favorites, ratings, notes, filters and search. Find recipes by name, ingredient, tag, source, cook time or nutrition.
PLAN MEALS
Use CookBook as a flexible meal planner for days, weeks or months. Plan from recipes you already love, scale servings, add notes and make weekly meal prep easier.
SHOP SMARTER
Create smart grocery lists from recipes or meal plans. CookBook merges ingredients, sorts groceries by aisle and syncs your shopping list across devices.
COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
Scale servings, convert units, use cooking timers, keep your screen awake and follow clean, readable recipe steps while you cook.
TRACK NUTRITION
Calculate recipe nutrition, view estimated calories and macros, and plan meals around your goals.
WORKS ACROSS DEVICES
Plan on your computer, shop on your phone and cook from your tablet. CookBook syncs your private recipe library across devices and the CookBook Web App.
BEST FOR HOME COOKS WHO:
• Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, websites and food blogs
• Replace screenshots, bookmarks and notes with one recipe manager
• Use a meal planner with automatic grocery lists
• Scan family recipes, handwritten cards and cookbooks
• Organize recipes with tags, filters and favorites
• Get AI recipe help while keeping control of their own recipes
QUESTIONS
What is CookBook?
CookBook is a private recipe keeper, recipe manager and meal planner for saving, organizing, planning, shopping and cooking from your own recipes.
How do I import recipes from Instagram?
Save the recipe to CookBook and turn it into a clean, editable recipe with ingredients and steps.
Can I import recipes from TikTok?
Yes. CookBook can help you import recipes from TikTok and other social recipe sources into your private recipe library.
Can I scan handwritten recipes?
Yes. CookBook can scan handwritten cards, cookbook pages and printed recipes into editable digital recipes.
Does CookBook make shopping lists?
Yes. Add recipes to your meal plan or shopping list and CookBook creates a smart grocery list sorted by aisle.
Does CookBook help with meal planning?
Yes. CookBook includes flexible meal planning for days, weeks and months, with shopping lists created from your planned meals.
Is CookBook private?
Yes. CookBook is a private digital cookbook for your own recipe collection, meal plans and shopping lists.
QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK?
Email team@cookbookmanager.com - we'd love to help!
PRICING & TERMS
CookBook is free to download. Store 20 recipes and use 20 smart imports free. Yearly plans include a 14-day trial where eligible. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in App Store account settings. Unused portions of a free trial or subscription period are non-refundable.
Terms: https://www.cookbook.company/policies/terms
Privacy: https://www.cookbook.company/policies/privacy

bluejetty:00045951:ios.name: ParcelBox - Package Tracker
bluejetty:00045951:ios.summary:
Tracking your shipments has never been more seamless and convenient than with ParcelBox. Never lose sight of your packages again. Download ParcelBox today and take the stress out of shipment tracking.
Our powerful, all-in-one tracking plat
bluejetty:00045951:ios.description:
Tracking your shipments has never been more seamless and convenient than with ParcelBox. Never lose sight of your packages again. Download ParcelBox today and take the stress out of shipment tracking.
Our powerful, all-in-one tracking platform allows you to monitor all your domestic and international packages from multiple carriers in one place. No more switching between different tracking websites or searching through emails for tracking numbers—ParcelBox simplifies the process and ensures you’re always up to date on your deliveries.
With ParcelBox, you gain access to real-time tracking updates, ensuring you always know where your package is and when it will arrive. Whether you’re waiting for an important document, an online order, or a gift for a loved one, ParcelBox provides detailed tracking information at every stage of the journey. Our advanced system automatically detects the correct carrier based on the tracking number and keeps you informed from pickup to final delivery.
We support over 2500 global postal and courier services, including USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Royal Mail, Canada Post, Australia Post, Deutsche Post, China Post, Japan Post, and many more. No matter where your package is coming from or where it’s going, ParcelBox ensures you have accurate, up-to-the-minute tracking details.
ParcelBox is designed for convenience, allowing you to save multiple tracking numbers and receive automatic updates for each shipment. The app’s intuitive interface makes it easy to check all your deliveries in one place without unnecessary distractions. Unlike other tracking services, ParcelBox is built with a clean, ad-free experience, ensuring that you get only the most relevant and important tracking information without any clutter.
Our system is especially useful for online shoppers who frequently order from various e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, eBay, AliExpress, Walmart, Etsy, ASOS, and many others. ParcelBox seamlessly integrates tracking information from these retailers, ensuring that you never lose track of your online purchases.
Key Features of ParcelBox:- Real-time tracking for both domestic and international shipments
- Support for over +2500 global courier and postal services
- The ability to save multiple tracking numbers for ongoing shipments
- Instant notifications about any status updates or delays
- A clean, ad-free, and user-friendly experience
- Detailed tracking history, so you can review past shipments anytime
ParcelBox is the ultimate tool for individuals and businesses looking to stay in control of their shipments without hassle. Whether you are tracking a single package or managing multiple deliveries, ParcelBox ensures you have the most reliable and accurate tracking information at your fingertips.
Privacy Policy: https://gentlemens.tech/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://gentlemens.tech/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00084269:ios.description:
The only payment link you'll ever need to send and receive payment.
Note from the creator:
The story of paylinkz started when I realized that anytime I needed to send money or pay for a service that was rendered to me - I would ALWAYS ask the question "what payment app do you have?". I noticed that some had Venmo, others had CashApp, and some had PayPal and Zelle combined. It came to my realization that some people had a strong preference for the payment app that they preferred. After all, we live in 2022 and no one ever carries cash on them.
The whole process of asking for usernames, figuring out the proper app to open on your phone, and then making sure that the right username has been entered seemed clunky and needed improvement. As a software engineer and an entrepreneur at heart, I went straight to work to build a unified platform that makes it easy to add all your payment profiles into one place.
The goal here is to switch the question from "what payment app do you have?". to "Send me your paylinkz URL" and to remove the friction from sending and receiving money.
I hope you find a lot of value in it.
Please see the following for agreements 
https://paylinkz.app/terms
https://paylinkz.app/privacy

bluejetty:00080439:ios.summary:
Starting solids? See exactly how to serve 200+ first foods at every age, track what your baby eats, and introduce allergens with confidence. Baby-led weaning, purees or a mix of both: this app supports the way your family wants to feed.
HO
bluejetty:00080439:ios.description:
Starting solids? See exactly how to serve 200+ first foods at every age, track what your baby eats, and introduce allergens with confidence. Baby-led weaning, purees or a mix of both: this app supports the way your family wants to feed.
HOW TO SERVE EVERY FOOD, BY AGE
Eggs, chicken, strawberries, broccoli: every food shows how to cut and serve it at 6, 9 and 12 months, with real photos, common choking risks and how to lower them. No more guessing whether a piece is too big or too small.
ALLERGENS, STEP BY STEP
Common allergens are clearly marked, with tips on how to introduce each one. Log every exposure and note any reaction, so you always know what your baby has tried and how it went.
A FOOD DIARY YOU CAN SHARE
Record new foods, favorites, foods to try next and any reactions. Share your baby's food history with your pediatrician, partner or caregiver.
GUIDANCE FROM FIRST TASTES TO FAMILY MEALS
Clear guides for 6 to 24 months: signs your baby is ready, how textures progress, gagging vs choking, and how to move from spoon-feeding to finger foods.
NUTRITION IN EVERY FOOD CARD
See the key nutrients in each food, including iron, one of the most important nutrients once babies start solids.
This app provides general educational information and is not a substitute for medical advice. Always talk to your pediatrician about your baby's individual needs.
SUBSCRIPTION
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00036868:ios.summary: OneLabel is a science-based product scanner that helps you understand what’s really inside your food and personal care products. Instantly scan barcodes to detect additives, allergens, controversial ingredients, and potential health risks —
bluejetty:00036868:ios.description:
OneLabel is a science-based product scanner that helps you understand what’s really inside your food and personal care products. Instantly scan barcodes to detect additives, allergens, controversial ingredients, and potential health risks — and get clear, unbiased insights to help you choose better for yourself and your family.
Whether you’re avoiding gluten, allergens, endocrine disruptors, or simply trying to live healthier, OneLabel gives you transparency, confidence, and control in seconds.
◆ WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH ONELABEL
1. Instant Barcode Scanner
Scan food, cosmetics, and personal care products to instantly see their health impact — in less than one second.
2. Ingredient Checker
Confusing labels made simple. OneLabel breaks down ingredients into clear explanations, highlighting:
* Additives & preservatives
* Allergens (gluten, dairy, soy, nuts, etc.)
* Endocrine disruptors & carcinogens
* Vegan & FODMAP suitability
3. Science-Based Product Ratings
Each product is evaluated using objective criteria:
* Nutritional quality
* Presence of additives
* Ingredient safety & formulation quality
No ads. No brand partnerships. No sponsored scores.
4. Healthy Alternatives
If a product isn’t ideal, OneLabel helps you discover better alternatives aligned with your dietary needs and lifestyle.
5. Cosmetic Safety Scanner
Scan or search cosmetics and personal care products. OneLabel deciphers complex INCI lists, flags potentially harmful components, and explains them in plain language — like having a digital cosmetologist in your pocket.
◆ SCIENCE IS OUR INFLUENCER
OneLabel ratings are built on real science, not marketing.
Our in-house team of biologists and physicians analyzes over 25,000 ingredients using the latest research in toxicology, nutrition, and dermatology.
AI-powered analysis combined with human curation ensures speed without sacrificing accuracy.
Carcinogens, allergens, endocrine disruptors — we track what matters.
◆ A MASSIVE PRODUCT DATABASE
* 3+ million food & cosmetic products
* New items added continuously
* Scan products from stores you already shop at:
Sephora, Ulta, Amazon, Target, Whole Foods, Kroger, and more
◆ WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE ONELABEL
* Unbiased & ad-free
* Science-driven, transparent scoring
* Food and cosmetic analysis in one app
* Clear explanations — no medical jargon
* Designed for real, everyday decisions
OneLabel doesn’t tell you what to buy — it helps you understand why.
◆ PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES
* Unlimited scans
* Unlimited food & cosmetic searches
* Ad-free experience
* Favorite products & tracking
* Access to all educational content
TAKE CONTROL OF WHAT YOU CONSUME
OneLabel empowers you to make informed, confident choices every day — at the grocery store, in the bathroom, or online.
Scan smarter. Choose better. Live healthier.
Premium Subscription Details:
Some features require a paid auto-renewable subscription (OneLabel Unlimited), including:
• Unlimited Scans
• Detailed Product Analysis
• Ad-Free Experience
A 7-day free trial may be available for new subscribers. After the free trial period ends, the subscription automatically renews at the applicable price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current billing period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://onelabel.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://onelabel.app/terms-of-service.html
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The Simpro Mobile ap
bluejetty:00071367:ios.description:
Connect the field to the office with Simpro Mobile and enhance the efficiency of your team.
Achieve end-to-end operations management with Simpro Premium, a complete job management software solution for your business. 
The Simpro Mobile app gives field staff the ability to do more on the job. Update job details, access site and asset history, view timesheets and present quotes with ease. 
FIELD SERVICE FEATURES:
Enhance your field processes with Simpro Mobile, an end-to-end field app. Streamline field service workflows, manage customer assets, increase first-time fixed rates and enhance the customer experience.
* Live scheduling updates
* Record travel time and time spent on-site
* Access scheduled and assigned, as well as search for any pending or progress jobs.
* See who else is scheduled to be on-site for the job
* Status changes, such as a completed job card, will trigger workflow processes for office staff
* Offline functionality
* Invoice and accept payments in the field, with different options including cash or credit card payments (Square Payments integration available depending on location)
* Click-to-call site and job details
* Pre and post-audits for enhanced safety
* Pause work to stop the clock at any time
* Comprehensive asset management
* Inventory management
* Add notes, photos and other attachments with immediate sync to office
* Capture staff and customer signatures and email a signed job card directly to any contact
* High accuracy GPS navigation
TIMESHEET FEATURES:
Build a workforce of time-savvy staff. Easily track costs throughout project and service work, and provide scheduling information to field staff to maximise productivity.
* Clock on and off daily
* Create new time blocks for quotes, jobs and activities
* Use pre-defined travel schedule rates (eg after hours or long distance) to categorise travel time
* Add or edit billable and non-billable work hours in real-time or retrospectively
* Update records in real-time or retrospectively for billable and non-billable work
* Easily spread time between multiple cost centres based on hours or percentage of working time
* Access site, customer and schedule notes along with other key details such as activities, job descriptions and cost centre information
* Copy time blocks for employees, contractors and plant equipment
* View multiple weeks including past, current and upcoming scheduled time.
* Compare work scheduled and completed to identify and rectify unaccounted blocks of time or conflicts
CUSTOMER QUOTE AND SALES FEATURES
Upsell and close more sales in the field with Simpro Mobile.
* Add images, videos and manuals to create visually appealing quotes on the fly
* Offer multiple quote options such as basic, intermediate and premium
* Incorporate memberships and other services with standard pricing and savings displayed
* Apply add-on pricing for discounted rates such as for multiple or same-day services 
* Email quotes and invoices to the customer

bluejetty:00074195:ios.description:
ePIS reune todas as informações realmente importantes para você acessar o dinheiro de seu PIS!
Tudo de maneira rápida, simples e segura! E além de calcular saldo e calendário de pagamento, você também pode tirar todas as suas dúvidas sobre o PIS.
Recursos
- Calendários PIS/PASEP 2024/2025 - Saiba de acordo com o mês do seu nascimento quando você deve receber seu Abono Salarial
- Calculadora Trabalhista de Abono - Calcule quanto você deve receber de acordo com o seu salário e meses trabalhados;
- Calculadora precisão para descobrir seu PIS;
- Leitor QR code
- Calendário de pagamentos;
- Contagem de dias restantes para o saque;
- Informações sobre crédito em conta;
- Notícias atualizadas;
E muito mais!
Não fique mais desatualizado nem pegue filas enormes para simples informações! Descubra tudo sobre seu PIS aqui no ePIS!
O que é PIS?
O PIS é um programa criado para bonificar quem trabalha de carteira assinada em empresas privadas.
Essa bonificação é paga anualmente para um determinado grupo de trabalhadores: você precisa ter trabalhado ao menos 30 dias no ano anterior, recebendo em média até dois salários mínimos e estar inscrito no PIS por ao menos 5 anos.
O valor máximo pago pelo PIS é de um salário mínimo, para quem trabalhou 12 meses.
O que é PASEP ?
Muito parecido com o PIS, que é voltado para trabalhadores de empresas privadas, o PASEP é um programa específico para funcionários públicos.
Muito Importante!
- Este aplicativo não possui vínculo com órgãos governamentais.
- Não somos um app governamental, e todas as informações são retiradas do site oficial do Governo (https://www.caixa.gov.br/beneficios-trabalhador/abono-salarial/).
- Fazemos uma simulação a partir do site oficial do Governo. Todas as informações disponíveis no aplicativo são originadas de dados abertos de fontes oficiais.
- O aplicativo não armazena nenhuma informação pessoal inserida durante o uso e está de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados brasileira.
Vale ressaltar que nosso aplicativo foi desenvolvido por uma empresa séria e que seguem rigidamente políticas de privacidade dos dados. Leia nossos termos de uso e política de privacidade.
Baixe agora o calendário atualizado PIS 2024 e PASEP e calculadora trabalhista!

bluejetty:00037832:ios.description:
MySivi AI -  Your Personalized English Speaking App to Improve English Fluency
MySivi is an english speaking app to help you speak English confidently through real conversations and AI guidance. Use it for interviews, classes, or daily talks with live practice, instant feedback, and personalized lessons to learn English speaking naturally.
MySivi ke saath english seekho aur apni communication skills ko improve karo.
Practice English in Real Conversations
Our English speaking practice app helps you speak English without fear through topic-based chats and real-time tasks. With MySivi, speaking English becomes natural through consistent practice.
AI English Coach for Instant Improvement
MySivi is an AI English speaking app that listens to you, corrects mistakes, and guides your practice. It offers pronunciation support for clearer spoken English, grammar improvements, and fluency tips using real-life examples. Many features are available free, making it a helpful English learning app for learners who want structured speaking practice and everyday English improvement.
Structured English Learning Path
Follow a guided plan for effective English learning. Every lesson in this English learning app helps you speak English with clarity. Our curriculum makes MySivi the perfect spoken English app for systematic skill building, aur yeh learners ko real conversations mein English bolne ki practice better karne mein help karta hai.
Translate and Learn in Your Language
Understand words in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Urdu, and more. This makes MySivi the perfect English learning app for Indian learners who prefer mastering English in their native language while building English speaking foundations.
Rewards to Keep You Motivated
Earn badges, streaks, and points as you improve your English speaking. MySivi gamifies your English learning journey, turning daily English practice app sessions into a fun habit.
Special Practice for Exams & Interviews
Boost confidence for IELTS, TOEFL, job interviews, and placements. This English speaking app helps you speak English fluently in real-life situations where clear spoken English matters most.
Flexible & Offline Learning
MySivi functions as an English speaking app offline with optimized modules. Access this English app anytime, anywhere.
Why Choose MySivi
MySivi blends AI intelligence with real conversations and instant corrections to help you learn English effectively. With guided lessons and quick feedback, it becomes a simple English sikhne wala app for everyday learners.
Perfect For:
● Beginners who want to learn English speaking from scratch with a free English speaking app
● Students studying for exams benefit from an English learning app that offers consistent speaking-practice support.
● Professionals who want to speak English fluently for workplace communication
● Learners seeking an english speaking practice app for daily conversation
● Anyone looking to learn English with an AI English learning app that provides personalized feedback
● Users seeking a spoken English app to improve speaking skills
● People who need an English practice app for IELTS, TOEFL, or interview preparation
● Learners looking for English learning in multiple regional languages
MySivi offers an easy way to practice daily and improve your English fluency.
Start Speaking English with Confidence
Practice with AI, and build fluency with MySivi - your English speaking app companion. Speak English clearly and naturally with AI feedback and conversation practice in this comprehensive English learning app.
Download MySivi now and begin your journey to better English communication - aur har conversation mein confidently English bole.
MySivi ke saath english seekho aur real-life situations mein confidently English bolna shuru karo.
If you have any questions or need any help, please reach out via in-app WhatsApp support. You can also email us at contact@mysivi.ai

bluejetty:00089163:ios.description:
Crafting a standout resume can be challenging, even for those who have navigated the job market before. However, this app takes the stress out of the process, providing a user-friendly and secure platform to create a resume that captures your qualifications and experience.
Your resume is more than just a document; it’s your first impression in the professional world. Whether you're applying for jobs, preparing for interviews, actively job hunting, or submitting your credentials on various job sites, a well-crafted resume is essential for success.
The app offers a variety of features designed to help you build a resume that stands out:
- Expertly Designed Templates: Choose from a selection of templates that have been crafted by professionals to meet industry standards. These templates ensure that your resume is not only visually appealing but also structured for clarity and impact.
- Comprehensive Tips and Examples: To help you present your experience and skills in the best possible light, the app provides detailed tips and examples. Whether you’re writing a summary, listing your work history, or highlighting your skills, you’ll have access to guidance that can elevate your resume from good to great.
- Real-Time Resume Preview: Before you finalize your resume, you can preview it to see how it looks from the employer's perspective. This feature allows you to make last-minute adjustments to ensure everything is perfect.
- Premium Template Options: For those looking to add an extra edge to their resume, premium templates are available through a subscription. These templates offer additional design elements and layouts that can make your resume stand out in a crowded job market.
- PDF Exporting for Easy Sharing: Once your resume is complete, you can save it as a PDF for easy downloading, printing, or sharing. The PDF format is universally accepted and maintains the formatting of your resume, ensuring it looks professional whether viewed on a computer, tablet, or smartphone.
This app not only simplifies the resume creation process but also empowers you to present your professional story in the most compelling way possible. Whether you're just starting your career or looking to make a change, having a polished, professional resume is a key step towards achieving your goals.

bluejetty:00028843:ios.summary:

Pet puppy games for kids is a veterinary simulator. Babies can try to be a pet doctor and take care of little animals. 
Play kids dog games and learn to wash
bluejetty:00028843:ios.description:
Has your kid ever wanted to have his own dog? Now toddlers' dreams will come true!
Pet puppy games for kids is a veterinary simulator. Babies can try to be a pet doctor and take care of little animals. 
Play kids dog games and learn to wash fluffy friends' feet, brush their teeth and cut the claws. Give your dog the necessary medication and get rid of germs. Bathe your pets in the baby dog games and save them from fleas.
Our app is in kids puzzle games format!
Your babies of 2+ yrs will be able to play a mini-game and to put all the pieces together to get a complete picture, to put a bandage on the dog's paw and to cure it.
~~~ Features ~~~
• 8 exciting mini-games on puppies brushing, caring and washing;
• Easy learn of basis of doggy games on taking care of pets;
• Learning the animal care tools;
• Development of kids fine motor skills with grooming gameplay;
• Fascinating interface and simple gameplay;
• The kid can use the app independently.
~ Mini dogs games for kids
In our learning toddler games for 2 year old kids, there is a possibility to try yourself as a vet, a stylist, a fashion designer and learn more about taking care of pets. Wash your dogs in a warm bath, brush their teeth and fur. Give some medicine and cure the disease.
~ Visit an animal hair salon
Make your little puppy more beautiful in toddler animal games! The child can make a stylish hairdo for his pet and then pick up interesting looks and accessories. Animal dress up game is a good way to develop a kid's sense of fashion. Choose what your pupies will be like and make them glamorous!
~ Learn the necessary toolkits
In kid dog games we provide your baby with all necessary instruments to take care of little puppies. Your toddlers can use a soft toothbrush to clean dog's teeth, cut the nails with a clipper or go to the bathroom and wash his pet with a smelling delicious shampoo.
~ Develop fine motor skills in preschool games
Toddler dog game for pre-k kids are great for training your little ones' fingers. Our infant games are designed in such a way that the child will have to press, drag, select, twist a lot. Children of 3+ years can enjoy their playtime in baby puppy games for preschoolers with no internet!
~ Simple interface and fun gameplay
Our application for girls and boys is easy to use and has a fairly simple interface, due to which the children will be able to play kids animal games on their own, without the help of parents. Now your kids can not only have a good time as a pet vet, but learn more about responsibility and how to take care of animals correctly.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. new kinds of dogs.
2. new mini-games.
3. new accessories.
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://brainytrainee.com/privacy.html 
And Terms of use https://brainytrainee.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00031274:ios.name: Arrow: Workout & Macro Tracker
bluejetty:00031274:ios.summary: Arrow is the #1 workout and nutrition tracker built for changing your body. Log your lifts, meals, and weight in one app, get calorie and macro targets that adapt to your real results, and see whether training and diet are actually adding u
bluejetty:00031274:ios.description:
Arrow is the #1 workout and nutrition tracker built for changing your body. Log your lifts, meals, and weight in one app, get calorie and macro targets that adapt to your real results, and see whether training and diet are actually adding up, whether you're cutting, bulking, or just looking to maintain.
TRAINING AND NUTRITION IN ONE LOOP
Changing your body is one problem, not two. Your lifts create the stimulus, your food decides what your body does with it, and your weight trend tells you whether the plan is working. Most apps track one piece. Arrow connects all three.
• Adaptive TDEE: Arrow estimates your real daily energy expenditure from your weigh-ins and food log, not just a formula, and keeps your calorie and macro targets adjusted as your body responds
• Scale Weight vs. Trend Weight: every weigh-in is plotted against a rolling trend, so you can tell a water swing from true gain or loss before you change your plan
• Oil detection: if a scanned meal was likely cooked in oil, Arrow asks before you log, so hidden calories don't slip past your numbers
• Arrow Score: one number built from Strength (PRs and volume), Nutrition (calories, macros, weigh-ins), and Consistency (workouts and meal logs), weighted for your goal. A cut and a bulk are scored differently.
• Estimated daily deficit or surplus and a four-week projection
• Arrow Coach flags when a sudden scale jump or drop is likely water, not fat
NUTRITION TRACKING THAT'S FAST AND HONEST
• Smart Scan: photograph your plate and get the foods, calories, and macros
• Describe a meal in plain words or by voice, scan a barcode, or look it up in the database
• Heads Up before you log a scanned meal, and a meal score when you do
• Edit any target yourself. Arrow never locks you into its numbers.
• Recent foods, saved meals, custom foods, and copy-a-previous-day for meals you eat on repeat
• Optional meal and post-workout reminders
WORKOUT TRACKER BUILT FOR THE GYM
• Log sets, reps, and weight in a few taps, no clutter mid-set
• Plan your own routines or generate one from your goal, equipment, days, and session length
• Flip any exercise card to see your history and personal records
• Rest timer, dropsets, cardio and activity tracking
• Custom exercises, swap exercises mid-workout, reorder on the fly
• Lock Screen Live Activity and Dynamic Island keep your workout in view
• Close the app mid-session and resume where you left off
ARROW COACH
Coach reads training and nutrition together: a recap of your week after workouts and on your Stats screen, a Heads Up on meals before you log them, and a call-out when a weight swing is likely water. Every note ends with what to do next.
PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• Muscle diagram shows which muscles you hit this week and how hard
• Volume, PR, and lift progress over time
• Week Overview calendar for training and nutrition days
• Apple Health steps on your Profile and in Performance
• Arrow Wrapped: your year in review
TRAIN WITH FRIENDS
• See your friends' workouts (and their meals, if they share them) in your feed
• Share workout cards to Instagram Stories
OPTIONAL GAMIFICATION
Want extra motivation? Turn on levels, streak multipliers, and trophies. 
SUBSCRIPTION
Access to Arrow requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
Powered by fatsecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com)
Barcode data also from Open Food Facts (openfoodfacts.org), licensed under ODbL.
Terms of Use: https://arrowfitnessapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://arrowfitnessapp.com/privacy
Questions? support@arrowfitnessapp.com

bluejetty:00068804:ios.description:
Unit Converter: convert any measurement, currency or size in one tap.
IN SHORT
A fast, offline unit converter that turns any measurement, currency or clothing size into the answer you need — with live exchange rates and a built-in calculator. If you can use a calculator, you can use this.
WHO IT'S FOR
Cooks, contractors, DIY-ers, students, travelers and anyone who needs a quick, precise conversion. Also handy for engineers, nurses and online shoppers comparing international sizes.
WHAT YOU GET
• 18+ categories in one place — weight, length, temperature, volume, speed, area, time, data, energy and more.
• Live currency conversion — real-time exchange rates, updated automatically.
• A real calculator built in — type an expression and convert the result instantly.
• Works offline — every unit (except live rates) converts with no connection.
HOW IT WORKS
1) Pick a category from the icon grid.
2) Tap the two units you want and type a value — or a full calculation.
3) Read the precise result instantly, to the number of decimals you choose.
KEY FEATURES
• Currency — live forex rates for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and more, plus crypto.
• Weight & mass — oz, lb, kg, g, mg, stone, metric tons.
• Length & distance — miles, km, yards, meters, feet, inches, cm, mm.
• Temperature — Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Réaumur, Rankine.
• Volume — cups, tbsp, tsp, pints, gallons, liters and metric volumes.
• Clothing & shoe sizes — men, women, kids and babies, across countries.
• Plus speed, area, pressure, data, energy, fuel and angle.
WHY IT HELPS
Most people find the unit they need in a couple of taps and never open a second app. Rates stay current, so a EUR→USD check is accurate to the day.
FAQ
Q: What is it, in one line?
A: A unit converter that turns any measurement, currency or size into a precise result using a built-in calculator.
Q: Does it work without internet?
A: Yes — all units convert offline. Only live currency rates need a connection to refresh.
Q: Can it convert currencies in real time?
A: Yes, exchange rates update automatically so conversions reflect the current market.
DOWNLOAD AND CONVERT
Pick a category and get your first conversion in seconds.
Naturally, this app helps with unit conversion, the metric system, imperial units, currency exchange, cooking measurements and clothing sizes.

bluejetty:00014963:ios.summary:
If your reading skills have been impacted by a stroke or brain injury, this app can help you improve. Practice reading with engaging exercises that include text and audio support.
** Try for FREE by downloading Advanced Language Therapy Li
bluejetty:00014963:ios.description:
If your reading skills have been impacted by a stroke or brain injury, this app can help you improve. Practice reading with engaging exercises that include text and audio support.
** Try for FREE by downloading Advanced Language Therapy Lite **
Advanced Reading Therapy uses technology to assist struggling adult readers to make sense of paragraph- and multi-paragraph-level passages. Self-ratings encourage metacognitive awareness, comprehension questions test accuracy, and hints enable greater success and independence. Score reports make it easy to see progress (and write progress notes) along the three graded levels:
* Level 1: Shorter passages of 50 words or less, written around a Grade 0 – 1 reading level. Three questions after each passage test comprehension.
** Level 2: Medium passages of 50-150 words, written around Grade 2 – 3 reading level. Four questions appear to see how well you understood.
*** Level 3: Harder passages get you ready for the texts you want to read. 150 – 600 words and Grade 3 – 6 reading level with five questions each. 
Adult readers will enjoy these functional and entertaining passages as they get back to reading the pages and screens in their own lives. Speech-language pathologists will love having so many modern reading passages with carefully-crafted questions at hand to teach strategies.
Built-in audio controls let you listen to a single word, go sentence-by-sentence, or hear the whole article – whatever you need. You’ll get over 200 reading rehabilitation exercises in 15 categories! 
Features:
• Text-to-speech available on touch
• Adjust font size, spacing, and rate at any time
• On-screen audio recording to listen to yourself reading aloud
• Self-rating of comprehension encourages metacognitive awareness
• Inference and prediction question encourage thinking outside the text
• Huge variety of topics to appeal to mature readers
• E-mail reports for easy data tracking
• Unique categories such as Jokes, Inferences, First Chapters, Text Messages, and Functional Passages
• Look back at the passage any time, or have the relevant text highlighted with a Hint 
Tactus Therapy offers a wide variety of apps to help with reading comprehension. Advanced Reading Therapy is the next step in your rehab after mastering the single words in Comprehension Therapy, the phrases & sentences of Reading Therapy, and the complex sentences of Advanced Comprehension Therapy. All of our apps work together to help you reach your reading goals. Find the right apps for you with our App Finder at tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00045204:ios.name: Lemonade Ordering
bluejetty:00045204:ios.summary: Alan Jackson is the founder and vision behind Lemonade, enticing Californians with the simple allure of beautifully prepared salads, hearty braised meats, satisfying sandwiches, decadent desserts, and of course, thirst-quenching lemonades.
bluejetty:00045204:ios.description:
Alan Jackson is the founder and vision behind Lemonade, enticing Californians with the simple allure of beautifully prepared salads, hearty braised meats, satisfying sandwiches, decadent desserts, and of course, thirst-quenching lemonades. A California native, Alan named the restaurant “Lemonade” because of the bright and comforting feeling you get when you simply say the word. The original sunny day spot!
An accomplished chef, Alan decided to ditch the upscale dining scene to launch the first Lemonade in West Hollywood in 2008, craving to create a chef-driven, contemporary approach to fine food. . . done fast. Alan’s confident yet relaxed concept has curated a loyal following and nurtured Lemonade into a neighborhood favorite.
In 2009, Ian Olsen came on board to join Alan as Partner, forging a dynamic relationship that has helped to redefine the fast-casual dining experience for today’s food-savvy diners. Ever-growing, Lemonade now has 27 locations throughout Los Angeles and surrounding areas, Orange County, San Diego, and the Bay Area.
Download our app to get rewards and extra perks. Here’s how it works:
1) Register your credit/debit card(s) in the app.
2) Shop as usual.
3) We’ll buzz your phone when you earn a reward. No need to fish your phone out, check-in, or scan anything. Just pay as usual.
4) Rewards show up on your phone for you to use. It's like magic!

bluejetty:00063802:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Wichita Falls area with the NewsTalk 1290 app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from NewsTalk 1290 Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the NewsTalk 1290 app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the NewsTalk 1290 app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00015798:ios.description:
What will your child learn today? In this animal sounds learning game, your toddler can explore six different categories: over 90 kinds of cute animals, insects, fruits, and vegetables. Kids will learn about domestic and wild animals, listen to animal sounds, and explore the world around them!
MEET THE CUTEST WILD & DOMESTIC ANIMALS:
FARM
Meet the lovable residents of the farm – a pink pig, a cuddly goat and a friendly puppy!
SAVANNAH
Go on a journey into the endless savannah. The kingly lion, spotty giraffe, stripy zebra, and other amazing wild animals want to play together!
FOREST
A brown bear, a gray bunny, and a fluffy squirrel live in the forest. They can't wait to meet the little explorer and introduce themselves!
GARDEN
Be sure to look around the garden because many wonderful creatures hide there: a green caterpillar, a gorgeous butterfly, a tiny ant, and many other adorable insects!
FRIDGE 
Many fruits and vegetables are concealed in the kingdom of ice and cold! A juicy tomato, a crispy carrot, and a sweet apple – find & learn them all!
BONUS GAME – ""SHOW WHERE?""
Listen to how different names are pronounced, choose correct images, and watch fun animations!
This app is a simple game and rich educational material at the same time! Did your child learn all the words? Now, you can let them learn animal names in a foreign language!
Press the Language button on the Settings screen to choose any language from the list and set the foundation for your child's multilingual development:
- English
- Spanish
- German
- Russian
- Italian
KEY APP FEATURES:
• More than 90 sounds and animations
We cooperate with professional voice-over actors to make every word sound clear and correct, for children to learn new words and memorize them easily. Besides, colorful animations and funny animal sounds will amuse your little one!
• Learning in a playful way
Bright pictures and captivating missions will attract the child's attention, helping to develop fine motor skills, improve memory, attention, and perseverance.
• Easy controls
The user-friendly interface allows your baby to use our learning application without any help from grown-ups. At the same time, purchases and settings are reliably protected from the accidental clicks of a curious toddler!
• Play offline with no ads!
Your little ones won't need an Internet connection to entertain themselves! Play anytime and anywhere – on a long journey or in a boring queue. The app is 100% safe for kids to use, as there are no intrusive ads.
Access 25+ educational apps for kids with an Amaya Plus subscription! Ignite your child's imagination and develop their essential skills with our game collection. Play offline, anytime, anywhere. Connect up to 3 devices for seamless fun. Join now and embark on an exciting learning journey for your little ones!
ABOUT US:
Our friendly team has been creating fun games for kids for over 10 years! To develop apps with the best kids' learning games, we consult the top children's educators and design vibrant, user-friendly interfaces that kids love to use. 
We love to make kids happy, and we also like to read your emails! If you need help, have questions, or want to say ""hi,"" please get in touch at info@amayasoft.com

bluejetty:00070288:ios.summary: A simple to use app that allows you to book spaces in seconds. With a few taps you can book a workstation or a meeting room, along with other areas like parking, lockers, quiet spaces, breakout zones and more. One screen in the palm of you
bluejetty:00070288:ios.description:
A simple to use app that allows you to book spaces in seconds. With a few taps you can book a workstation or a meeting room, along with other areas like parking, lockers, quiet spaces, breakout zones and more. One screen in the palm of your hand keeps you in control of your daily schedule. See all your bookings, find booked workspaces on a floor plan, and make changes or cancellations to bookings as required. It’s never been faster to check in to a workspace, through a simple tap of a button, or automatically through proximity-based check in. When you need to collaborate with a co-worker, Eptura Engage helps make it happen. You can search in the app to find where they’re working, book an available workspace nearby and start collaborating in minutes.
Requires Eptura Engage subscription. Types of spaces that can be booked within the app depend on your organization's configuration.

* Ratings - See how your ratings change over time and by country.
* Ad Revenue - Dive into your ad revenue from all platforms with trends for total impressions, eCPM, fill rate, and more.
* Ad Spend - See how your ad campaign are performing across all ad networks.
Hundreds of thousands of app and game developers rely on Appfigures to made better decisions and growth their downloads.

Just install our HD video player & get all media files in one place and play your favorite videos in HD quality with all format video player.
HD video player provides all media player features you need to play videos and gives an attractive user interface that gives you the best user experience. The video player app quickly fetches all media files available on your device and arranges them on the dashboard. You can classify all media files by the downloading sources that help you play your favorite video quickly. All format media player enables you to share, rename or delete any video you want.
All Format Video Player
Play all format videos including MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, RMVB, TS, etc.
HD Video Player
Play HD, Ultra HD, 1080p & 4k video files smoothly in an HD video player all formats.
Files manager
Identify all video files on your device and SD Card automatically. In addition, manage or share videos easily.
Background playback
HD media player enables you to play video in the background just like a music playback. keep playing videos even after switching to another app or turning off the screen
HD player with speed control
Users can quickly change the video playback speed in the range from 0.5x to 2x with this media player.
Smart Gesture control
Easily use gesture control to adjust the volume, brightness, and playing progress by sliding on the playback screen.
KEY FEATURES: 
● Support ALL video formats, including MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, RMVB, TS, etc.
● Ultra HD video player, support 4K.
● Hardware acceleration.
● Night mode, quick mute & full-screen view.
● Identify all video files on your device and SD Card automatically.
● Manage or share videos easily.
● Easily rename files or delete duplicate videos.
● Easy to control volume, brightness, and playing progress.
● Enable you to keep playing video when switching to another app or turn off the device screen
● A-B Repeat & loop mode available in media player.
● Video player HD for both android tablets and android phones.

MKStreamer helps you to locally stream every common video format (.mkv, .avi, .wmv and a lot more) with a click of a button.

- AirPlay any video to Apple TV
- Stream all your movies to Smart TV and Chromecast 
- Watch movies on all your mobile devices

- Automatically load available subtitles
- Adjustable performance to optimize CPU and disk usage
- Stream multiple videos
- Alternate audio tracks and multilingual subtitles
** Stream your movies to Apple TV, Smart TV and Chromecast **
Simply select your Smart TV, Apple TV or Chromecast device from the Control panel and watch your movies on big screen
** Scan QR code or share stream link **
On iOS and iPadOS you can simply point the camera to the QR code. The Camera app helps you to start watching the movie with a simple click
MKStreamer uses HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) protocol, an adaptive bitrate streaming communications developed by Apple Inc.
There are freely available HLS players on every major platform.
Important note:
- Devices can only play streams if they are connected to the same local network as your Mac. The connection can be wireless, using WiFi or wired, using Ethernet.
